name: wavelet_denoising_thresholding
decomposition_rationale: Wavelet denoising cleanly splits into forward DWT decomposition, statistical threshold calculation with coefficient scaling, and inverse reconstruction. This separation allows substituting custom thresholding algorithms.

atomic_nodes.name: compute_hierarchical_dwt
atomic_nodes.semantic_role: Computes 1D discrete wavelet decomposition coefficients down to a specified level.
atomic_nodes.witness_shape_semantics: Decomposes vector of length n into a list of coefficients of decaying dyadic scales.
atomic_nodes.complexity_reasoning: Filtbank cascade implementation scales linearly with input size.
